user_intent: Never concatenate role and company in search bar; enter either designation, keyword, or company name as single entities and ensure search button is explicitly clicked.
why_user_made_such_thinking: Live portal monitoring showed searches combining role and company (e.g. Java Architect EY) failing or yielding zero results due to platform parser constraints.
why_user_performed_this_way: Empirical user testing on live Naukri UI: recognized portal search engine expects isolated entities rather than complex compound strings.
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Firm, precise architectural corrective instruction targeting search ergonomics.
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes: restructured search task matrix into ROLE_ONLY and COMPANY_ONLY strategies, eliminating all combined ROLE_AND_COMPANY executions.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Refactored core/04_job_discovery.py to enforce single-entity search matrices and explicit click confirmations.
evolutionary_takeaways: Compound search queries on Indian recruitment portals degrade search accuracy; pure single-entity queries are mandatory.
